parole.significato: market, marketplace (a square, a building, a space, where agricultural and/or industrial goods are sold and bought; the…
parole.testo: Some consider this word borrowed from Old East Slavic търгъ (tŭrgŭ, “market, commerce”), which agrees with the u in Lithuanian (and Latvian dialectal) tur̃gus, but not with the i in standard tirgus. Others propose that it is the natural development of Proto-Baltic *terg-, *tirg-, from Proto-Indo-Eur
